aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but mis-groups the primary comparison and several outcomes.
issues: Changed factor wrongly mixes normal, test #7 OK, #7 bending, #9, and totals as both baseline and test.
Primary comparison should be add 0.05mm test molds #7/#9 versus normal mold, not #7 bending as control.
VP/CD outcome omits the normal row and compares #7 OK to #9 incorrectly.
Function outcome omits normal control and conflicts with decision that test #7/#9 are worse than normal.
Measurement outcomes are header-derived artifacts, not valid measurements.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to VP mold center add 0.05mm for test molds #7 and #9 versus normal VP mold #8/Normal.
Use row 21 as Sub1 normal control for rows 19 and 20.
Use row 32 as VP/CD normal control for rows 26, 28, and 30 as applicable.
Use row 60 as function normal control for rows 52, 56, and 58.
Remove header-based measurement outcomes and cite purpose, result, and decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations do not support the draft grouping or judgements.
